task: Resolve the Recv buffer-pinning hazard through receiver-owned pending mailbox delivery.
acceptanceCriteria: ipc_send, ipc_post_nonblock, and ipc_try_send never write a foreign Recv buffer
parked Recv and RecvTimeout tasks drain owned messages after wake
IRQ UART messages avoid heap allocation and mailbox backpressure is fallible
heap payload quota is charged and refunded to the receiver cell
death-owned wakes precede later queued messages and ipc_send backpressure returns TryAgain
shell input, burst input, request/reply VFS, and keyboard flows remain operational
publicContracts: Recv sender identity and truncation semantics remain unchanged
ipc_send reports mailbox backpressure as SyscallError::TryAgain
RecvScatter remains behaviorally deferred while foreign writes are removed
scoutSummary: The three producer paths retained raw Recv pointers across suspension; deferred owned delivery closes that hazard while keeping the existing task-state protocol.
